result.fusion_win: 1.46x and 1.35x over the naive three-pass shape (max, then exp+sum, then divide), both CANDIDATE_WINS with clean arms. That is the value of doing all three inside one threadgroup instead of re-reading the row twice.
result.vs_mlx: NO_CLAIM at both shapes -- 133.5 against 141.1 and 133.5 against 131.1 GB/s, which straddles parity and does not clear the noise in either direction. No win is claimed and no loss is either.
result.what_it_unblocks: softmax was the missing prerequisite between the reduction and attention. Attention itself is still ABSENT -- this is one of its pieces, not attention.

claim_boundary: A correct, numerically stable, fused row softmax exists in AIR and beats the naive three-pass shape by about 1.4x. Against MLX it is INDISTINGUISHABLE and no claim is made either way. f32 only, last-axis only, no masking, no causal variant, no batching beyond rows, and NO ATTENTION -- softmax is a piece of attention, not attention, and nothing here was run inside a model.
